decision.reason: [ev-ef448e5a23b4] says only that the Loki Helm chart now lets you define resources for GrafanaAgent pods. It does not name a Helm values key and does not say what happens to environments that do nothing. The proposed condition relies on guessed keys ("grafanaAgent", "agents") and an unrelated Deployment gvk-in-use test, so the evidence does not support it. To settle exposure, I need the PR 11851 diff of the chart values/templates, giving the values path and any default resources applied when it is unset.
